exception_policy.client: Set actual APIClient.raise_request_exception=False, retain its value; use normal Original resolver/middleware/exception handling, no overridden handler or monkeypatch
exception_policy.request_result: Record transport_kind=http_response only if response object returned, raw status/body/headers/contenttype and response.exc_info original type/message/traceback if attached. Otherwise transport_kind=framework_exception with original exception type/message/traceback and no invented HTTP body/status. Expected500 remains hypothesis and cannot substitute for missing response.
exception_policy.fixture_outer_catch: Separate source_fixture_exception record identifies setup/request/capture/teardown phase and current index; process/controller outcomes distinct from request results. Preserve partial report and flush it; ownership/capacity or fixture errors may stop sequence; do not pretend all48 executed. finally default audit/cleanup still attempted.
exception_policy.deployment: Framework APIClient response or exception is not a deployed WSGI/ASGI/TCP status claim.
